name: branding-reset-wordmark-with-reversed-s-and-blue-applications
title: Bold italic RESET wordmark with a flipped s, shown in electric blue on a dark laptop and phone dock
whatItIs: A white slide with a heavy italic black 'REset' where the s is mirrored, a tiny caption 'reset it company', and two photos: a blue wordmark glowing on a dark laptop against concrete, and a blue app icon with a stylised R among iOS icons on a blue background.
whatItMeans: Clever and kinetic; the flipped letter makes 'reset' visible.
techniques: Flip one letter to illustrate the name's meaning.
Show electric blue on dark and on a phone dock.
Reduce the mark to a single-letter app icon.

vocabulary.definition: A letter flipped horizontally as a concept device.
A simplified app icon based on the logo.
